obernants.operator: For fixed n and modulus m, the preimage of y contains all admissible seed/coefficient pairs whose nth term is y modulo m. Preserve every congruent seed and coefficient representative. At n=0 only the first seed is constrained; for zero seeds all coefficient vectors qualify for y=0. No unique recovery is implied.
